import datetime
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
lane=root.parent/'codex-home/skills/phi-e2e-lane/scripts/lane'
manifest=json.loads((root/'scratch/frozen-manifest.json').read_text())
assert manifest['frozen']
kind=sys.argv[1]
assert kind in ['browser','recorder']
statepath=root/'scratch/batch-state.json'
state=json.loads(statepath.read_text()) if statepath.exists() else {'completed':{},'attempts':[]}
log=(root/'scratch/batch.log').open('a',buffering=1)
def save():statepath.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2))
def run(args,timeout=None):
    log.write('\nCOMMAND '+repr(args)+'\n')
    result=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=timeout)
    if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Command failed, see batch.log: '+repr(args))
def lane_cmd(args,timeout=120):return ['python3',str(lane),'run','--timeout',str(timeout),'--']+args
active=None
items=manifest['tasks'] if kind=='browser' else manifest['recorderSamples']
order=[('A',1),('B',1),('B',2),('A',2),('A',3),('B',3)]
for index,item in enumerate(items,1):
    taskid=item['sourceRecord']['task_id'] if kind=='browser' else item['sample']
    for group,rep in order:
        planid=f'{kind}:{taskid}:{group}:{rep}'
        if planid in state['completed']:continue
        seq=1+sum(x['planId']==planid for x in state['attempts'])
        prefix=f'{kind}-{index:02d}-{group}-{rep}-{seq}'
        assert re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9-]+',prefix)
        entry={'planId':planid,'prefix':prefix,'kind':kind,'taskId':taskid,'group':group,'repetition':rep,'attemptSequence':seq,'startedAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'state':'starting'}
        state['attempts'].append(entry);save()
        print(json.dumps({'event':'start',**entry}),flush=True)
        if active!=group:
            run(['python3','scratch/switch-lane.py',group],timeout=150);active=group
        if kind=='browser':
            original=item['sourceRecord'];request={'objective':'Start at '+original['website']+'. '+original['confirmed_task'],
                'mode':'new-tab','sessionId':f'{manifest["experimentId"]}:{taskid}:{group}:{rep}:{seq}',
                'maxSteps':25,'timeoutMs':900000,'captureTrajectory':True}
            (root/'scratch/active-request.json').write_text(json.dumps(request))
            run(['python3',str(lane),'sync','scratch/active-request.json','scratch/active-request.json'])
            run(['python3','scratch/run-attempt.py','../../scratch/active-request.json',prefix],timeout=1140)
            run(['python3',str(lane),'run','--cwd','phi-ai/browser-use-eval','--timeout','600','--','pnpm','exec','tsx','../../scratch/judge-driver.mts','../../results/'+prefix+'/http.json','../../results/'+prefix+'/judge.json'],timeout=630)
        else:
            run(['python3','scratch/run-recorder.py','../../recordings/'+taskid+'.json',prefix],timeout=300)
        run(['python3',str(lane),'pull','results/'+prefix+'/', 'scratch/results/'+prefix+'/'])
        summary=json.loads((root/'scratch/results'/prefix/'summary.json').read_text())
        if kind=='browser':
            judge=json.loads((root/'scratch/results'/prefix/'judge.json').read_text())
            summary['judgeScore']=judge.get('verdict',{}).get('score');summary['judgeError']=judge.get('error')
            if summary.get('title',{}).get('truncated'):
                run(lane_cmd(['python3','scratch/stop-agent.py'],30));active=None
        entry.update(state='completed',finishedAt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),summary=summary)
        state['completed'][planid]=prefix;save()
        print(json.dumps({'event':'completed','prefix':prefix,'taskId':taskid,'group':group,'repetition':rep,'summary':summary}),flush=True)
print(json.dumps({'event':'batch-complete','kind':kind,'completed':sum(k.startswith(kind+':') for k in state['completed'])}),flush=True)

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

work = Path(os.environ['LANE_WORKDIR'])
repo = work / 'phi-ai'
secrets = json.load(sys.stdin)
env = dict(os.environ, **secrets)
env['PATH'] = str(repo / 'phi-agent-dsh/node_modules/.bin') + ':' + env['PATH']
log = work / 'agent-dev.log'
args = ['node', '../scripts/sentinel-dev.mjs', '--id', 'phi-agent',
        '--env', 'PORT=' + os.environ['LANE_AGENT_PORT'], '--env', 'ENABLE_LOOPBACK=true']
for name in secrets:
    args += ['--pass-env', name]
args += ['--', 'env', 'PORT=' + os.environ['LANE_AGENT_PORT'], 'ENABLE_LOOPBACK=true', 'NODE_OPTIONS=--import=' + str(work / 'scratch/env-snapshot.mjs'), 'tsx', 'watch', '--clear-screen=false', '--env-file=env/package.env.stage',
         '--env-file-if-exists=.env', '--tsconfig', 'bundle/tsconfig.json', 'bundle/src/boot.ts']
with log.open('a') as output:
    p = subprocess.Popen(args, cwd=repo / 'phi-agent-dsh', env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                         stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
(work / 'agent-dev.pid').write_text(str(p.pid))
print(json.dumps({'launcherPid': p.pid, 'log': 'agent-dev.log', 'port': os.environ['LANE_AGENT_PORT']}))

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
work=Path(os.environ['LANE_WORKDIR']);repo=work/'phi-ai'
credentials=sys.stdin.read()
group=sys.argv[1]
assert group in ['A','B']
if (work/'agent-dev.pid').exists():
    subprocess.run(['python3',str(work/'scratch/stop-agent.py')],check=True)
values={'RECORDER_SKILL_MODEL':'phi/agent/recorder','BROWSER_TASK_TAB_GROUP_TITLE_MODEL':'phi/browser-agent/title',
        'BROWSER_AGENT_SONIC_PLANNER_MODEL':'phi/browser-agent/planner','BROWSER_AGENT_SONIC_FINAL_ANSWER_MODEL':'phi/browser-agent/final-answer'}
if group=='B': values={k:'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-Fast' for k in values}
envpath=repo/'phi-agent-dsh/.env'
envpath.write_text(''.join(k+'='+v+'\n' for k,v in values.items()));envpath.chmod(0o600)
started=time.time()
subprocess.run(['python3',str(work/'scratch/start-agent.py')],input=credentials,text=True,check=True)
runner='/Applications/Phi Canary.app/Contents/Library/LoginItems/Phi Sentinel.app/Contents/MacOS/runnerctl'
auth=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([runner,'--channel','canary','--compact','get-auth-token'],text=True))
exports=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([runner,'--channel','canary','--compact','call','--method','getComponentExports'],text=True))
route=exports.get('ai-gateway',{}).get('models',{}).get('agent',{})
assert route.get('provider')=='phi' and route.get('requires_model') is True and not route.get('request_model'), 'Agent route overrides the experimental models'
with (work/'route-snapshots.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'at':time.time(),'group':group,'agent':route})+'\n')
for i in range(50):
    try:
        request=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:'+os.environ['LANE_AGENT_PORT']+'/api/v1/browser-evals/status',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+auth['auth_token']})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=2) as response:
            body=json.loads(response.read())
        if body.get('available'):
            (work/'active-group').write_text(group)
            print(json.dumps({'group':group,'ready':True,'managementDurationMs':round((time.time()-started)*1000),'models':values}));break
    except Exception:
        pass
    time.sleep(1)
else: raise RuntimeError('Agent failed readiness within 50 probes')

executionScripts.stop-agent.py:
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

pidfile = Path(os.environ['LANE_WORKDIR']) / 'agent-dev.pid'
pid = int(pidfile.read_text())
command = subprocess.check_output(['ps', '-p', str(pid), '-o', 'command='], text=True).strip()
assert 'sentinel-dev.mjs' in command, command
os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
for _ in range(50):
    result = subprocess.run(['ps', '-p', str(pid), '-o', 'command='], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode:
        print('Recorded launcher exited:', pid)
        pidfile.unlink()
        break
    time.sleep(.2)
else:
    raise RuntimeError('Recorded launcher did not exit')
